forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: すくめていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To draw in or raise one's shoulders, either as a gesture of uncertainty or to make oneself smaller. Most commonly used in the phrase {肩|かた}をすくめる (to shrug one's shoulders).

examples.japanese: ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すくめ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧た。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すくめ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧て⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: He shrugged his shoulders and laughed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すくめ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧て⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: She shrugged as if to say she didn't know anything.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すくめる: to shrug one's shoulders (the most common usage)
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すくめる: to draw in one's neck, to duck one's head

PAIR: すくめる（⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧）↔ ⟦すくむ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧（⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧）= to freeze, to cower

USAGE: Almost always appears with ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ or ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ as the object. The gesture of shrugging shoulders is less natural in Japanese culture, so this expression often appears in translated literature or when describing Western-style gestures.
